Navigate to the High Level Planning task page, or open the Compare Alternatives task page. 2. If you selected: * The High Level Planning task page, in the BOP panel, open the action menu for the BOP root node to open the full BOP, or for a line or station to open a partial BOP. * The Compare Alternatives task page, in the source or target panel open the action menu forthe BOP root node to open the full BOP, or for a line or station to open a partial BOP. 3.
